title: Fixed abelian counit comparison constructors
statement: For a scheme X and a module sheaf F [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-normalization], define the same terminal-source Ext precomposition and fixed site-sections comparison as before. For an abelian injective resolution R [def-sp-injective-resolutions], define abelianInjectiveResolutionIso as that comparison followed by R.isoRightDerivedObj of global sections. The direct-image functor and adjunction are the abelian inverse-image/direct-image pair [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. These are the existing counit constructors moved below the cocycle calculation; the injective constructor is proved equal to its previous acyclic-resolution form.

lean.statement:
def abelianInjectiveResolutionIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (R : InjectiveResolution
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F)) (p : ℕ) :
    AddCommGrpCat.of (H F p) ≅
      (((abelianSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex).homology p
